firstPlayerRule: Choose a player to go first. Play then proceeds clockwise around the board.
clarifications: In the two- and three-player variations, the playing order is blue, yellow, red, green.

internalEvidence: Downloaded the English instruction sheet linked from Mattel's customer service product page for the Blokus Game (product BJV44; 2–4 players, 84 pieces in four colors, 21 per color) and extracted the text with pdftotext. PDF page 1, Setting Up: choose a player to go first; play proceeds clockwise. PDF page 4, Game Variations: for two and three players the playing order is blue, yellow, red, green.
